name: farmflow-site
description: www.farmflowcaribbean.com: the FarmFlow web marketplace (web/) plus the static marketing pages, deployed to Firebase Hosting.

scripts.build: tsc -p web --noEmit && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && node scripts/assemble.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.build:emulator: tsc -p web --noEmit && VITE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=1 vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && node scripts/assemble.mjs
